name: Calcium malate
description: Calcium malate (CAS 17482-42-7 ), also identified as E352 , is the calcium salt of malic acid used in food and pharmaceutical manufacturing as an acidulant, buffering agent, and mineral supplement source. It delivers both pH control and bioavailable calcium in a single ingredient, reducing the need for separate additives. In food and beverage production, it functions as an acidulant and flavor enhancer. It is frequently used in fruit-based products, confectionery, and soft drinks where a clean, mild tartness is required. Pharmaceutical formulators use it as a calcium source in dietary supplements and mineral tablets. This is particularly effective where malic acid co-administration supports absorption. It also acts as a stabilizer and buffering agent in processed foods, helping maintain target pH through thermal processing. In functional food development, it appears in calcium-fortified products targeting bone health positioning. It provides these benefits without the chalkiness associated with carbonate-based calcium sources. Calcium malate is supplied as a white to off-white powder. It is available in food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications, with compliance to FCC and Ph. Eur. standards commonly referenced. Bulk quantities are typically offered in 25 kg bags for industrial use.
